why: Fighter 6 + Rogue 6, character level 12, PB 4. From the Ashes (Worthless Husk origin feat) gates its picks by character level (4, 8, 12, 16, 19), not by class level. Scores: base 15,14,13,12,10,8 + background DEX +2 CON +1 = 15,16,14,12,10,8 (75). Worthless lowers the highest until total 72 (DEX 15, STR 14, DEX 14) then each -1: 13,13,13,11,9,7. Picks: level 4 STR +2 = 15, level 8 CON +1 DEX +1 = 14 and 14, level 12 STR +2 = 17. The level 16 pick (STR +2) is stored but not counted at level 12, so STR stays 17. A class-level gate would stop at Fighter 6 or Rogue 6 and lose levels 8 and 12. HP: Fighter level 1 = 10+2 = 12, levels 2-6 = 5x8 = 40, Rogue 6x(5+2) = 42, total 94.
